name: VANTA
description: Flagship eight-voice synth: two oscillators per voice, a resonant ladder filter and a 24-slot modulation matrix. Playable in-browser demo, presets and full docs included.

name: DRIFT
description: Tape delay with correlated wow and flutter, head-gap loss on repeats and a record path that saturates before it distorts.

name: PRISM
description: Four spectral bands you can move, tilt and resonate independently. Public beta — the 1.0 release is a free update.

name: ANVIL
description: Transient shaping and bus compression in one signal path, with saturation after the gain element. Version 2.0.1.

name: The Full Shop
description: All four plugins in every format we ship, on one licence file for three machines. Bought separately they come to $386.
